_doc: Void atmosphere of the Krypta der Verdammten (story 1, live crypt run only; src/vfx/crypt_atmosphere.gd, docs/KRYPTA-ATMOSPHAERE.de.md). Presentation only, drawn by each client. grade: colour filter on the room (floor, walls, props), never on heroes, enemies or shots. darkness: overrides balance.json lighting.darkness while the atmosphere is on. fog: drifting mist layers (world px, px per second). flames: wall torches, candle columns and floor fires repainted onto the 0x72 violet ramp; light_color/glow tint their light.
